app_name: Restaurant POS System - Ingredient Movement Report

body.numeric_data: font-mono text-sm tracking-wide font-medium text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200

labels.badge: text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full
labels.table_header: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

layout.sidebar_location: Daily Report section, directly below 'Item Consumption' report link

page_structure.main_area: flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 overflow-y-auto p-6 md:p-8 space-y-6
page_structure.header_bar: flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800
page_structure.filter_bar: flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 p-4 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm

key_features_and_components.navigation_back: ArrowLeft icon back button returning to Daily Reports overview or previous section

movement_toggle.rule: Strictly separated views — Received shows incoming stock transfers (franchise ↔ central ↔ master), Dispatched shows outgoing stock transfers. Never blended into one combined table.
movement_toggle.styles: bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 p-1 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1

date_range_picker.custom_date_inputs: Dual date pickers (Start Date, End Date) with popover calendar or native input formatted for POS style

search_filter.placeholder: Search free text for ingredient name or SKU...

parent_row_columns: Unit of Measure (e.g., kg, L, units, bags)
Total Quantity Transferred (highlighted in mono font)
drilldown_subtable_columns: Status Badge (Received / In Transit / Dispatched / Pending)
collapsible_ingredient_table.interaction: Clicking parent row toggles drill-down section with smooth animation and subtable formatting.

excel.button: Button variant='outline' size='sm' className='gap-2 text-slate-700 hover:text-orange-600 border-slate-300 hover:border-orange-500'
excel.behavior: Triggers CSV / Excel download of current filtered Received/Dispatched movement report data.

pdf.button: Button variant='outline' size='sm' className='gap-2 text-slate-700 hover:text-orange-600 border-slate-300 hover:border-orange-500'
pdf.behavior: Opens print-friendly report popup or triggers PDF export with formal header, summary metrics, and detail breakdown.

empty_state.title: No Ingredient Movements Found
empty_state.description: No stock transfer records match your current date range and search filter.

loading_state.loader: Subtle skeleton pulse cards and table row placeholders with spinner overlay during API call.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. File extension note: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files for React components.
2. Ensure the sidebar navigation incorporates 'Ingredient Movement' directly in the 'Daily Report' menu group right below 'Item Consumption'.
3. Maintain strict toggle separation between 'Received' and 'Dispatched' stock transfers.
4. Default date range filter MUST be 'Last 7 Days'.
5. Use `#F97316` (Tailwind orange-500) as the primary brand accent for active toggles, highlighted totals, and focused controls.
6. Include drill-down nested transfer lines showing From Store, To Store, Dispatched date, Received date, Qty, and Status badges.
7. Add standard Excel (CSV) and PDF print export functionalities with shadcn outline buttons.
8. Attach all requested data-testid attributes for automated test suite verification.
